origin: Codex 0.142.5: the relay stops an answer with finish_reason length after some text. Codex names no output limit, so the limit is the gateway's own default (16,000 tokens unless the operator set another, and no more than the model writes; D14), which is no limit of the client's to report: the response is completed, as every native account's is (an incomplete one is a failed stream to Codex, which sends the request again, five more times, and every answer of a relay is paid for). The relay answers are authored from the documented Chat Completions shapes; the expected files are what the gateway does with them.
